name: pidgeon
description: Mailboxes for agents: create addresses, read threads, send mail, and receive arriving mail as signed webhooks.

PIDGEON_API_KEY.title: Pidgeon API key
PIDGEON_API_KEY.description: Optional. Leave it empty and Cursor signs you in to Pidgeon instead. For an agent with nobody there to sign in, a key from https://pidgeon.ai/app/developers/keys, with the narrowest access the agent needs.
